pipeline: videotestsrc num-buffers=20 ! video/x-raw,format=NV12,width=320,height=240,framerate=30/1 ! queue max-size-buffers=3 max-size-bytes=0 max-size-time=0 ! identity sleep-time=3000 ! videoconvert ! video/x-raw,format=I420 ! fakesink sync=false
gate_reason: normal pipeline reached EOS within gate thresholds
state_history:
Init: service created
Init -> ValidateConfig: validate CLI and scenario
ValidateConfig -> ProbeTools: probe gst tools and backend element
ProbeTools -> BuildPipeline: construct gst-launch pipeline
BuildPipeline -> RunPipeline: run gst-launch and capture output
RunPipeline -> ParseEvidence: parse output into counters
ParseEvidence -> EvaluateGate: evaluate objective pass/fail gate
EvaluateGate -> ExportMetrics: write enterprise_metrics.json
